title: Introducing the Enhanced Spyglass Tool
summary: We're thrilled to officially launch the enhanced Spyglass tool, now available with refined capabilities to empower your journey.

title: Enhanced File Management in the Editor
summary: Experience powerful new ways to manage and display your files directly within the editor, giving you complete control over your content.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: We've made checkboxes bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable, empowering you with a smoother, more intuitive way to manage your tasks.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've made it easier and more intuitive to collaborate with others in real-time, boosting your team's productivity.

title: Seamless Shared Content Discovery
summary: Empower your collaborations by seamlessly finding and accessing all shared content from your connections, ensuring every great idea is within reach.

summary: We are open-sourcing Noeko to empower our community with maximum control, direct involvement, and full transparency in shaping the future of the project.

summary: Noeko is expanding its horizons by integrating comprehensive support for multiple international languages, making our platform accessible to a global audience.

summary: Soon, you'll enjoy a more personalized and visually appealing interface with significant improvements to current themes and the addition of several stunning new options.

title: Smarter Knowledge Map for Easier Discovery
summary: Experience a revitalized knowledge map that offers intuitive filtering by tags, time, and shared connections, transforming how you explore and organize your information.

summary: Experience a more powerful search engine that lets you precisely filter, sort, and save your knowledge into custom views for instant recall.

title: Visualizing Your Connected Ideas
summary: Effortlessly structure your ideas with new visual displays that let you preview and interact with linked content directly within your notes for a more intuitive experience.

title: Unlock Noeko: Self-Hosted & Advanced Plans
summary: Prepare to unlock Noeko's full potential with the upcoming launch of flexible self-hosted deployment options and powerful paid plans designed for both individual users and growing enterprises.

title: Smarter Homepage Greetings
summary: Our latest update ensures your homepage greeting always accurately reflects the current time, providing a more precise and welcoming experience.
